## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.backend-src-common-guards.331a91ed"></a>**1. The unit exports `CustomThrottlerGuard`, an `@Injectable()` class that extends `ThrottlerGuard` from `@nestjs/throttler` and is documented as adding rate limit information to the response so that the `RateLimitHeadersInterceptor` can add appropriate headers.**
  [`custom-throttler.guard.ts:14-19`](../custom-throttler.guard.ts#L14-L19)
  [`custom-throttler.guard.ts:1-7`](../custom-throttler.guard.ts#L1-L7)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-guards.03354d0c"></a>**2. `AppModule` registers `CustomThrottlerGuard` as a global guard through the `APP_GUARD` provider and configures `ThrottlerModule.forRoot` with a 60-second TTL and a limit of 100 requests.**
  [`app.module.ts:14-14`](../../../app.module.ts#L14-L14)
  [`app.module.ts:22-27`](../../../app.module.ts#L22-L27)
  [`app.module.ts:36-42`](../../../app.module.ts#L36-L42)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-guards.f1aa9f05"></a>**3. The unit defines a `RequestWithContext` interface that extends the express `Request` type with optional `requestId` and `userId` string fields.**
  [`custom-throttler.guard.ts:9-12`](../custom-throttler.guard.ts#L9-L12)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-guards.65b3f8cd"></a>**4. The unit's `index.ts` re-exports all public members of `./custom-throttler.guard.js`.**
  [`index.ts:1-1`](../index.ts#L1-L1)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-guards.3df3c657"></a>**5. `CustomThrottlerGuard.handleRequest` overrides the base throttler's `handleRequest` to compute a tracker key from the request, increment the storage counter, attach rate limit information to the response as a `rateLimitInfo` property and `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers, and, when the request count exceeds the limit, set a `Retry-After` header, log a warning with request context, and throw `ThrottlerException`.**
  [`custom-throttler.guard.ts:21-81`](../custom-throttler.guard.ts#L21-L81)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-guards.b98d9ce0"></a>**6. `CustomThrottlerGuard.getTracker` returns the request's IP address, falling back to `req.connection?.remoteAddress` and then to the string `'unknown'`.**
  [`custom-throttler.guard.ts:83-86`](../custom-throttler.guard.ts#L83-L86)
